included_components: Medicare Hospital Insurance and Supplementary Medical Insurance program outlays and financing context
Medicaid and CHIP federal outlays and federal-state financing context
marketplace premium-tax-credit and related federal subsidy context
federal public-health, health-research, provider, and delivery accounts classified to the lane
federal administration where classified within the lane
adjacent_context_not_additive: CMS National Health Expenditure Accounts economy-wide health spending
state and local Medicaid shares and other subnational health spending
employer and household premiums and out-of-pocket spending
provider quality, access, rural-capacity, and safety-net indicators
excluded_or_separate: veterans health accounts assigned to the veterans lane
worker compensation and other income-security transfers
state, local, household, employer, and private-insurer spending as federal outlays
intragovernmental transfers counted again as program resources
lane_perimeter.double_count_rule: Do not add economy-wide NHE, state/local shares, private spending, trust-fund receipts, premiums, or intragovernmental transfers to federal function 550/570 outlays. Each may enter only through an explicit reconciliation bridge.

source_inventory.not_authorized: no automatic program, fund, or financing decomposition

source_inventory.role: Medicare enrollment, part financing, and HI/SMI context
source_inventory.not_authorized: not a substitute for a reconciled federal outlay path

source_inventory.source_family: CBO federal subsidies for health insurance
source_inventory.role: Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, marketplace, and employment-based subsidy baseline context
source_inventory.not_authorized: no mixed-vintage stitching or replacement of missing latest-publication bytes

source_inventory.role: economy-wide payer, service, and source-of-funds context
source_inventory.not_authorized: not additive to federal budget outlays

source_inventory.source_family: CMS quality and access indicator series
source_inventory.role: provider access, quality, rural-capacity, and safety-net evidence
source_inventory.not_authorized: no threshold, pass/fail, or fiscal effect

next_package_gate.required_output: one source-vintaged FY2025 anchor and FY2026-FY2035 federal baseline with explicit bridge rows and nulls

public_warning: HLT-A-01 freezes a bounded health/Medicare perimeter and inventories five source families. It does not add economy-wide, state/local, private, or trust-fund context to federal outlays. The annual baseline, financing bridge, policy scenario, rate, savings, HLT-A closure, and HLT-B start remain blocked.
